claims.excerpt: Clinically proven to completely cure dry skin
claims.claim_text: The product is clinically proven to completely cure dry skin.
claims.explanation: No clinical evidence in the knowledge base supports a complete cure for dry skin; FACT-001 only validates visible skin hydration improvement across 4 weeks.

claims.claim_text: The product delivers flawless radiance in 2 days.
claims.explanation: There are no retrieved facts supporting results within 2 days or claims of achieving flawless radiance.

claims.claim_text: The product is the #1 ranked formula.
claims.explanation: No fact in the knowledge base supports a #1 rank claim or market leadership status.

tone.excerpt: Discover the miracle powers of our new age-smart serum!
tone.explanation: Uses miraculous promises and exaggerated phrasing ('miracle powers') rather than plain-spoken, grounded dermatological language.
Asserts an unverified rank and supremacy claim ('#1 formula'), violating guidance against aggressive dominance claims and arrogant chest-beating.
Promotes unrealistic perfectionism ('flawless radiance') instead of celebrating natural skin texture and inclusive user needs.
